set.request: Build a TABBED CARD on the AI 2 card page: Overview (what it is, state, refined summary) and Tasks (sub-cards as the table of contents, grouped under headings by a `group` line appended to each sub-card). Vocabulary card / request / task. Reuse ext/tabs, remember the open tab per card. Full ask in requirements.md.
steps: Read card.js, ext/tabs, groups.js and the Cards fold
Append the group lines to the Dictate card's requests
Tabs + grouped request list in card.js
Headless screenshots 1920 / 3440 / 390, both tabs, zero console errors
set.outcome:
**A top-level card on AI 2 now has two tabs, Overview and Tasks, and the Tasks tab groups its requests under headings.** On the [Dictate card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/24/prompt-mechanics-2/) the 13 requests sit under Chat layout, Dictation box and Chat messages. At 3440 the three groups sit side by side as columns.

![Tasks tab at 3440](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/tabbed-card/shots/tabbed-card-3440-tasks.png)

- **Overview** shows what the card is, its bar and cost, its summary (the latest refined reading, else the first thing you said), and a line such as "13 requests, 0 done - see Tasks".
- **Tasks** shows the requests and, below them, the agents' task pages. The tab you last opened is remembered for each card.
- The words on screen are now *card*, *request* and *task*: "+ request", "13 requests", "talk into this request".
- A request is grouped by one `{"group": "..."}` line appended to its own log; with no groups the list stays flat.
- The chat column, the third column that opens a request, and the resize handles all work as before.

Fixed on the way: a refined-summary line would have turned a card's type into "refined"; it is now kept as the summary.

Code: [card.js](/framework/ai2/card.js) - [ai2.css](/framework/ai2/ai2.css) - docs: [AI 2 card doc](/framework/ai2/doc/cards/).

Left as it is: a group line written while a card is open shows on your next visit, not live.
